events_with_month.content:
RYUKI 映画初出演

映画『RYUJI ⻯⼆』


⻯⼆にかつて傷を負わされ、深い因縁を抱く敵対組織の宮内役には、8⼈組ダンス＆ボーカルグループ・MAZZELのメンバーとして活躍するRYUKI。

⻯⼆に過去の因縁を突きつける存在を、鋭い眼光と迫⼒あふれる演技で体現します。

なお、RYUKI は映画初出演となり、本作で俳優デビューを果たします。


MAZZEL RYUKI の初出演をぜひスクリーンでご覧ください。


▼詳細はこちら

https://www.culture-pub.jp/ryuji_movie/
events_with_month.content_en:
RYUKI Makes His Film Debut

The movie “RYUJI Ryu-ni”


RYUKI, a member of the eight-person dance and vocal group MAZZEL, plays Miyauchi, a member of a rival organization who was once wounded by Ryuji and harbors a deep grudge against him.

With his piercing gaze and powerful performance, he embodies the character who confronts Ryuji with their past feud.

This marks RYUKI’s first film appearance, making his acting debut in this film.


Be sure to catch MAZZEL’s RYUKI in his first film role on the big screen.
